children: Walker & Dunlop entered into Amendment No. 9 to its Master Repurchase Agreement with JPMorgan Chase, extending the facility's termination date to September 9, 2027. A Third Amended and Restated Side Letter updates fees, commitments, and pricing. The company continues to guarantee obligations under the facility. The changes are intended to maintain liquidity and financial flexibility.
